Dùng chắt chắt đã làm sạch từ nơi bán uy:
Use cleaned chat chat clams from a reputable seller. If buying them in their shells, soak them and change the water to release sand.
Avoid boiling the clams after their shells have just opened, or the meat may turn tough.
Serve the soy sauce and chili sauce separately so the clams' natural sweetness remains prominent.
Chỉ dùng nấm tràm được nhận diện và sơ c:
Use only tram mushrooms identified and prepared by a trusted supplier. Do not forage wild mushrooms without expert knowledge.
Blanch fresh mushrooms as directed by the seller and rinse before cooking. Thaw pre-cleaned frozen mushrooms in the refrigerator.
Add the mushrooms near the end and cook just until tender; prolonged cooking can make the broth more bitter.
